item.text: The implementation shape is straightforward: snapshots are first-class rows, story metadata is upserted by HN id, ranks live in a join table, and FTS5 mirrors saved titles for `search`. I’m keeping the HN API client async so `fetch` can gather story item requests concurrently and remain easy to test.
Core files and tests are written. I’m adding the long-form README now, then I’ll lock/install with uv and run the full suite to flush out integration issues.

The README now covers install, all eight subcommands, examples, architecture, dev flow, Docker, CI, and roadmap. I’m syncing the environment and running `pytest -v`; any failures from Typer/Rich/sqlite integration will get fixed before moving on.

The persistence fix is in. Per your instruction, I’m rerunning the entire verbose suite after this meaningful change before adding anything else.
